messages:
lee: Heads-up: hit a dup-side-effect bug in the onboarding sample when a streaming call got a 429 during token rotation. sketching a small SDK-level Safe Replay opt-in to keep app code simple.

nina: yep saw that in support. users expect "resume" to be transparent but webhooks got invoked twice. can you summarize the proposal?

lee: short version: SDKs offer safeReplay:true (off by default). when enabled the SDK will: attach Idempotency-Key for non-stream requests, persist last resume token client-side, coalesce parallel retries (singleflight), and do backoff-with-jitter before resume attempts. server will accept Last-Resume-Token and a replay-window TTL to decide replay vs fast-forward.

omar: singleflight is critical — we had two concurrent refreshes that retried and both replayed side effects. how do we avoid adding too many surface knobs?

lee: keep API tiny: one boolean + optional config object for backoff tuning. default backoff is conservative so users rarely need to touch it.

rachel: curious about the backoff defaults you picked.

lee: prototyping defaults (example):

```json
{"maxRetries":"5","baseMs":"150","maxMs":"4000","jitter":"full","retryOn":"429,503,network_error"}
```

lee: resume request headers example:

```
Idempotency-Key: uuid4
Safe-Replay: true
Last-Resume-Token: <token>
```

nina: streaming specifics: what signals let the server decide to fast-forward vs replay?

lee: server keeps a short-lived resume log keyed by logical request id + token. if token is within replay window and the request hasn't completed, it replays missing output; if outside window it will fast-forward from the newest state. window default = 60s but route-configurable for Dedicated/Private.

omar: storage and privacy concerns for storing tokens — agree keep default short. docs should explain tradeoffs.

lee: agreed. also SDK emits hooks so apps can surface when a resume was a replay vs fast-forward: onReplayAttempt(info), onReplayOutcome({status}). Console will surface that trace.

build-bot: created issue DEVEX-909: add e2e that simulates 429 + token rotation during streaming. assigned to @omar.

rachel: sampleapp addition request: include an express webhook that dedupes by Idempotency-Key and a producer that demonstrates resume/fast-forward. also small README blurb on when to opt-in.

lee: draft README blurb: "Enable Safe Replay for routes where at-most-once side effects matter; it reduces duplicates at cost of small resume latency. Use idempotency keys for permanent side effects and prefer server-side dedupe."

omar: also add a test that simulates two parallel token refreshes to validate singleflight.

nina: good plan. timeline?

lee: i'll open parity PRs for Node/Python today, Go already prototyped. then sampleapp + CI e2e next week. posting RFC to /eng tomorrow for feedback.

rachel: thanks. adding a Console UX ticket to show "safe replay used" per request for support traces.

lee: thanks all — want to avoid more onboarding surprises.

nina: thanks, very clear.
